tools.name: is_business_day
tools.description: Whether a date is a business day on one or more settlement calendars (NYSE, Fedwire/FedACH, TARGET2, UK), which holiday closes it, NYSE early closes, and the previous/next business day. Deterministic, no AI. Price: $0.001 USDC per call via x402 (Base); the first 5 calls per day per client are free.

tools.name: add_business_days
tools.description: Adds (or with negative days subtracts) N business days to a date on a joint calendar (NYSE, Fedwire/FedACH, TARGET2, UK) and lists the holidays skipped. Deterministic, no AI. Price: $0.001 USDC per call via x402 (Base); the first 5 calls per day per client are free.
